This forest was special, you knew it, so you delved deeper into the forest*

*Upon closer inspection on the leaf, you realize that it has a slight contour of blue. Mesmerized, you decide to take it home with you. However, as you turn back, you hit yourself with what it seemed like a wall, making you flich backwards*
